hook: Houses *inside a lake's legal line* were demolished in Ramanthapur.
hook_b: Houses *inside a lake's legal line* were demolished in Ramanthapur.
tldr: HYDRAA demolished houses built in the full tank level zone of Pedda Cheruvu in Ramanthapur.

beats.what: Deccan Chronicle reports HYDRAA demolished houses inside the Pedda Cheruvu FTL (full tank level) in Ramanthapur.
beats.why: FTL is the lake's legal water-spread line; construction inside it is treated as encroachment.
beats.care: If you rent or buy near a lake, check the FTL map before paying a token amount.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Deccan Chronicle: houses in the Pedda Cheruvu FTL, Ramanthapur, were demolished. Number of houses and owner notices were not in the headline.

cards.q: Houses razed inside a lake's FTL. Where do you stand?

learn.t: FTL means Full Tank Level, the highest water line of a lake; buildings inside it are treated as encroachment.

insight: FTL is a lake's highest water line; building inside it counts as encroachment.
